operator_stimulus: Lift the (l,k) two-vector by rotation, reflection and duality; eliminate redundant linkages once; explain R(l,k)-lk.

objective.scope: General relational arithmetic; the operator has left the domain open. Each route declares its domain, exceptions, and whether a signed interpretation applies. A finite pilot settles only its cases.
objective.statement: Find an intrinsic rotation/reflection/duality lift into a traced or spanned 4D or 8D configuration and one operation eliminating redundant linkages. Recover the two coordinates. Read both coordinates and identifiable additional cells from the same reduced object. At (3,7) exhibit two distinct surviving extra cells. Treat signed cancellations as a separate extension. Then predict C=lk+correction. Compare with the Ramsey threshold only afterward.
objective.closure_rule: Require the literal (3,7) witness and a separately authorized family scope. Require a reviewed proof of source generation, dimension, equivariance, cell semantics, quotient soundness, coordinate recovery, and both universal threshold bounds for one and the same route and declared scope. Numerical agreement and child outcomes alone cannot close the root.

coherence_obligation: forward realization before attachment transport, then invariance under changes of viewpoint and readout descent

semantics.candidates: alternative routes; the root requires at least one complete route, not every candidate
semantics.dimension: Record ambient dimension, orbit cardinality, and linear span separately.
semantics.correction: literal additional cells for the main claim; signed arithmetic belongs to a separate extension
semantics.duality: Each route defines duality and proves its action on cells and coordinate recovery; color exchange is one candidate.

conjectures.claim: For the normalized positive-sign seven-point DFT the square reverses indices and the fourth power is identity; complex phase multiplicities are 2,2,2,1.
conjectures.criterion: Four phases describe an action; justify the actual dimension separately.

conjectures.claim: The specified 4-cube cut at |sum x_i| <= 2 retains 14 vertices and removes the two antipodal corners.
conjectures.criterion: For geometric cuts, derive the cutting rule from the inputs before claiming an intrinsic correction. The two removed corners belong to a different count than the two extra cells at (3,7).

conjectures.claim: The ten-state AGL(1,5) orbit of RGR00 and (3,5) admissibility uniquely select the edge decoder up to isomorphism.
conjectures.criterion: For this seed give an independent choice of decoder: four admissible masks yield two graph types. Every such branch under legal vertex addition stops by order 11.

conjectures.claim: For two induced C5 views sharing two roles, the fixed red interface gives 2q+7q^2+3q^3 legal fillings weighted by new red edges; blue gives zero.
conjectures.criterion: A reduction representing this join must retain the distinction between red and blue interfaces.

conjectures.claim: Over the 39 catalogued 33-edge residuals, uniform, vertex-additive and unrestricted nonedge-pair coefficients certify 0, 19 and 39 classes, respectively.
conjectures.criterion: For this certificate family distinguish coefficient order from the number of shared types. Catalogue completeness remains an assumption.
conjectures.verification: reported exact certificate; full replay data unavailable here

conjectures.claim: On residual 1253 a coefficient function of the sorted endpoint degrees, common-neighbor count and independent-five-set frequency attains certificate mass below six.
conjectures.criterion: The reported exact dual gives mass >=157135/24654 > 6. Every coarsening of those 21 classes inherits this bound; a four-type remedy must cut across that partition or change the certificate.
conjectures.verification: reported exact dual; source certificate unavailable here

conjectures.claim: The simultaneous (3,7) clock orbit has 21 points and real linear span four.
conjectures.criterion: Use distinct Fourier characters of orders 3 and 7; verify the 21 distinct phases.

conjectures.claim: A quotient of only the l*k product positions can recover every Ramsey threshold.
conjectures.criterion: Compare maximum possible quotient size at (3,7) with 23.

conjectures.claim: The complete continuation language at a fixed root suffices across all root changes.
conjectures.criterion: Compare the four-role path and cycle after the identical attachment at the other root.

conjectures.claim: Freeze one candidate lift, linkage generator and single reduction together, before calculation or comparison.
conjectures.criterion: Supply domain, symmetry actions, 4D/8D space, trace or span proof obligation, literal linkage occurrences, equality, baseline and a cell-level correction rule. Ramsey values are external controls.

conjectures.claim: Product-clock linkage or face orbits, rather than position orbits alone, supply the cells.
conjectures.criterion: Specify allowed linkages before testing coprime, common-factor and equal-frequency cases.

conjectures.claim: A four-reading incidence lift admits one Mobius reduction over its decomposition order.
conjectures.criterion: Specify precisely which occurrences each cancellation identifies as redundant; justify the signed domain and derive correction witnesses before lookup.

conjectures.claim: Four ordered two-color readings are candidate labels for a lift with sufficient boundary when quotient equality uses continuation in every allowed frame.
conjectures.criterion: Define allowed contexts independently; show substitution and change of root preserve the quotient.

conjectures.claim: An intrinsic partition of coefficient pairs into at most four shared reading types retains the six-port obstruction.
conjectures.criterion: Freeze the intermediate-role and orientation rule and coefficient-sharing scope before fitting. Check all 39 residuals with exact primal certificates or an exact infeasibility witness.

conjectures.claim: The four-type pair-weight representation supplies a reduction to intrinsic cells.
conjectures.criterion: Define equality of weight measurements and derive integer cell multiplicity; an upper-bound certificate alone is insufficient.

conjectures.claim: Eight ordered three-link readings are candidate labels for a lift supporting a single quotient by equivalent assembly histories.
conjectures.criterion: Specify elementary changes of bracketing and prove they preserve completions. Reproduce both colors of the C5 interface.

conjectures.claim: One chosen candidate defines one equivariant linkage elimination with explicit cell semantics. A signed formula must identify its cancelled occurrences.
conjectures.route_alternatives: Any frozen named or novel branch may satisfy this gate through the route journal.
conjectures.criterion: Prove both directions of the proposed equivalence and identify how the reduction counts cells. Retain the same route identifier downstream.

conjectures.claim: The reduced structure recovers the two coordinates under the declared duality; the lift realizes its declared trace or span.
conjectures.criterion: Recover the parameters from incidence without passing their labels through as metadata. Prove dimension including degeneracies.

conjectures.claim: C is the first forbidden order for the same reduction.
conjectures.criterion: Construct an avoiding coloring on C-1 roles and prove that every coloring on C has a forbidden clique. Test the unchanged rule on the declared family.

lifecycle: reviewed scoped closures in the route journal; contract verdicts are baseline controls
